newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Moribund T-bonds capped by 107-28 barrier.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Moribund T-bonds capped by 107-28 barrier.

text.p: June T-bond futures need to pierce a strong barrier around the 107-28 area in order to escape the range that has hemmed in the contract through April, technical analysts said on Friday.
U.S. March producer price and retail sales data at 1230 GMT may provide the impetus, they said.

"It just has to break that if we are going to go anywhere," Marc Ostwald, technical strategist at London Bond Broking here. "Overall they are trying to bottom but there seems to be neither buyers nor sellers."
T-bonds were at 107-09 at 0925 GMT, down 2/32.
The contract has been consolidating through April with highs from 107-23 to 107-28 capping it on top.
A 38.2 percent retracement of the drop from the March 25 high of 109-25 to the low of 106-23 on April 4 also comes in at 107-28.
David Wood, independent technical analyst near London, agreed that area was key. The 13-day simple moving average provided additional resistance at 107-18 this session and 107-22 from Thursday.
"The moving average has controlled this all the way down," he said on Reuters Financial Television.
Ostwald said once above that 107-28 barrier, the March 26 low of 108-04 would be the next target.
"In the long run, this very low volatility we have suggests we are going to go for a decisive break at some stage, probably up," he added.
On the downside, Ostwald put initial support this session at 107-02,03, the lows from April 10 and April 7 respectively.
"If that broke -- and we're going to need something spectacular from the figures if it is to break -- then we're going to go back and have a look at the old lows at 106-23," he said.
The market hit a low here on April 4 and a 106-25 low on April 1.

March producer prices were expected to be unchanged from the 0.4 percent drop in February, according to a poll by Reuters. Retail sales were expected to be up 0.6 percent, down from February's 0.8 percent gain.
June Eurodollars were quoted at 93.725 at 0916 GMT, down 0.005 from Thursday.
Similar to T-bonds, September Eurodollars have built up a strong barrier in the 93.75 area, Wood said.
